thread:
Priya: heads-up — ACME wants a tenant-only accelerated onramp for a quantized 'q-lite' model. pilot in ~3w, asking for a 60d pin-exception and faster onboarding than catalog SLA.
Alex: can we meet perf/quality targets on our edge pool? what hardware are they targeting?
Samir: did a quick smoke on 2xA10 (edge sim): batch=1 p50 21ms / p95 69ms. small QA set: ~1.8% quality delta vs float.
Maria: ACME SRE asks: p95 <= 75ms + quality loss < 2% for acceptance. also require Splunk log forward + customer-managed KMS.
Priya: timeline's tight. request eng to produce a short fast-path checklist, tenant-scoped pin behind FF, and a one-pager for legal.
Jamie: tenant-scoped pins are fine. proposed flow: 1) 200-prompt eval harness (include long-context cases), 2) tenant-only canary 48h, 3) monitor & widen. Add auto-fallback to hosted model on failure.
Samir: important: quant degradation often shows on long prompts. recommend 30% of harness prompts be >=1024 tokens. will instrument hallucination and token-accuracy metrics.
Alex: infra gating: require sustained p95 <= 80ms during 48h canary at ~3k reqs/day. auto-unpin + route to default if violated.
Maria: legal/security: need a 1-page addendum covering KMS, log routing, and consent for forwarding. @Priya pls loop Legal. I'll own the eng acceptance checklist.
Priya: looping legal now. Product asks to prepare onboarding doc, compatibility note, and default 60-day TTL on pin exceptions (extensions via product+legal sign-off).
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: canary/q-lite -> tenant:acme @ 2024-10-18T09:23:00Z. CI: green. infra-reserve: pending.
Samir: actions:
- eval harness + run (Samir)
- canary FF + auto-unpin lambda (Alex)
- onboarding docs + customer comm template (Priya)
- legal addendum draft (Priya/Maria)
Target: canary ready in 12 days.
Alex: quick Q re rollback: prefer auto-unpin with immediate routing to baseline and a short notice to customer.
Maria: auto-unpin + 30min notify to oncall + ACME contact. reduces manual ops.
Priya: agreed. set auto-unpin triggers = `p95 > 80ms OR quality_delta > 2.5% (rolling 1h)`. alerting to pager + email to ACME primary.
Jamie: add canary observability checklist: per-route token-cost, latency histograms, error traces, token-diff traces. include ops runbook snippet for oncall (manual rollback steps + contacts).
Samir: I'll run the 200-prompt harness and post results here within 24h. abort canary if hallucination or token-loss spikes.
legal: reviewed initial ask; will draft 1-pg addendum today. need confirmation on exact Splunk endpoint and KMS key ARN.
Priya: thanks. i'll collate ACME contacts and share a customer comm template that explains fallback behavior and notice windows.
Alex: i'll build the auto-unpin lambda and provision the canary pool.
Priya: final: pin-exception TTL = 60 days default. extension requires product+legal sign-off and documented customer acknowledgement of compatibility risks.
Jamie: tiny ask: include a canned customer message that clarifies rollback behavior and expected customer notice time.
Priya: will include. reopening thread when canary start ts is confirmed.
Samir: uploaded harness results (linked) — initial numbers look within acceptance but long-form edge cases need one more pass.
Priya: great work. post blockers here. closing for now.
